newsitem.title: CANADA: Great Lakes Power to sell Brascan shares. [CORRECTED 23:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes Power to sell Brascan shares. [CORRECTED 23:40 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline and text throughout to make clear Great Lakes Power Inc intends to sell and not buy Brascon shares.)
Great Lakes Power Inc said on Tuesday that it agreed to sell 6.38 million class A common shares of Brascan Ltd for C$31.25 a share.
The Brascan deal was valued at C$199.4 million, Great Lakes said.
Great Lakes said it planned to sell 4.5 million of the class A shares to the public. An affiliate of Edper Group Ltd agreed to buy 1.8 million class A shares.
Great Lakes said it would file a preliminary short-form prospectus for the offering within two business days. The offering was expected to close on or about February 4.
